Smallest reproduction, from the workspace root:

$ ls -la .env
ls: cannot access '.env': No such file or directory

$ python3 -c "import os; print(repr(os.environ.get('DATA_API_KEY')))"
None

$ grep -ril -E "enrich|DATA_API_KEY|api_key|endpoint" .
(no output)

The brief requires the enrichment table to be fetched from the enrichment service with DATA_API_KEY from .env before any training, and requires this session to pause and ask through the inbox when the key is missing. The key is missing, so no training has been run and no enrichment table has been synthesized.
tried: Ruled out everything I could fix myself: (1) no .env at the workspace root nor anywhere up the tree to the campaign root; (2) repo-wide grep for enrich|DATA_API_KEY|api_key|endpoint matches nothing, so the repo's README, docs and config name no variable under another name; (3) .kapso/repo_memory.json contains none of 'enrich', 'data_api_key', '.env' or 'endpoint' (checked all 7 sections as one JSON blob); (4) the only .env on this machine is the campaign operator's own at /home/ubuntu/kapso/.env, whose key names are OPENAI_API_KEY, GH_TOKEN, PYPI_TOKEN, LEEROOPEDIA_API_KEY, HF_TOKEN, FIREWORKS_API_KEY, BRIGHT_DATA_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN(2), BENTO_CLOUD_API_KEY/ENDPOINT, X_APP_SECRET, X_BEARER_TOKEN, OPENROUTER_API_KEY — no DATA_API_KEY and no enrichment endpoint; (5) `env | grep -i -E "data_api|enrich"` is empty. Not a transient failure: there is nothing to retry against, because no endpoint is named anywhere. requests 2.34.2 is installed, so the fetch itself is not the blocker.
fix:
Create .env in the directory you run kapso from (/home/ubuntu/kapso/.env already exists — add the line there, or create .env at this workspace root) containing:

DATA_API_KEY=<the key>

And, in your reply, the two things the key alone cannot supply, because nothing in the repo names them:
1. the enrichment service base URL and endpoint path (e.g. https://host/v1/enrichment?ids=...), plus the auth scheme (bearer header vs query parameter);
2. how the enrichment table keys to our rows — I expect a column joinable to `id` (train C000001-C010000, holdout C010001-C013000), and whether holdout ids are covered.

If no such enrichment service exists in this environment, say so explicitly and I will proceed on base features alone — that is your call to make, not mine to assume.
next_steps: I will (1) parse .env with a small reader, fetch the table with requests, and cache it once to kapso_datasets/enrichment.csv (CSV, since pyarrow is absent) so predict.py never makes a network call or reads the key inside the evaluator's 600 s subprocess; (2) screen every enrichment column for post-churn leakage by univariate AUC and drop anything > 0.95; (3) run the already-planned enrichment-agnostic build_features over base.merge(enrichment, on='id', how='left') — it treats every non-id/non-label column as a feature and auto-splits numeric vs categorical, so no rework is needed whatever the table's shape; (4) tune LightGBM / HistGradientBoosting / ExtraTrees / spline-elastic-net LR offline under RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x3, seed 20261024), rank-blend with train-OOF percentile maps and greedy OOF weights, freeze the config into predict.py, assert the four exit-2 contract conditions, smoke-test with --fast, then spend the single experiment on one full `python kapso_evaluation/evaluate.py` run. The recon profile (kapso_evaluation/eval_profile.md) and PLAN.md are already committed, so resuming costs no rework. If your reply is that no enrichment service exists, I run that identical pipeline on base features alone.

note: DATA_API_KEY is now in .env in both the campaign and the project. There is no enrichment service and no enrichment table available. Proceed using the existing base data only; the enrichment requirement is removed. You must reach 0.85 ROC AUC without the enrichment table. Keep the evaluation protocol and target intact.
